CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_City_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_City
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS CityId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS CityName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'CITY'
WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_City FROM TEMP_BNKM_City;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_City_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CityId
,CityName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, CityId,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_City WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_City_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CityId
,CityName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, CityId, FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM BNKM.City --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_City_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CityId,TGT.CityId) AS CityId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CategoryId,TGT.CategoryId) AS CategoryId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_City_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_City_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CityId = TGT.CityId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_City_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_City_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 CityId  = SRC.CityId 
,CityName  = SRC.CityName 
,CategoryId  = SRC.CategoryId 
FROM BNKM.City TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_City_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CityId = TGT.CityId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_City SRC ON SRC.CityId = TGT.CityId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.City
([CityId]
,[CityName]
,[CountyCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     CityId AS CityId
    ,CityName AS CityName
    ,NULL AS CountyCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_City
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_City;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_City_DELTA;

END
